description: A shell script for testing various git diff and diff-tree commands, including setup, checking differences, conflict markers, and submodule states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp.

methods.name: test_reset
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Runs git diff commands with specified options.
